description: Figure 16 presents a bar chart illustrating Shapley values relative to the position of the probed target word, with values averaged across 247 tasks. The horizontal axis displays relative positions, labeled from -8 to 8, in integer increments, representing the distance from the target word. The vertical axis represents Shapley values, ranging from approximately -0.05 to 0.05, with tick marks at 0.0 intervals.  There are 17 bars, one for each relative position. The bars are colored a uniform shade of blue. The bar corresponding to position 0 has a value of approximately 0.02. The bars for positions -8 and 8 are the shortest, each with a value of approximately -0.03. The bars for positions -1 and 1 are the tallest, each with a value of approximately 0.03. The bars are arranged sequentially from -8 to 8, and no bars are visually emphasized.
